A mathematical operation used to select or compare indices.

== Mathematical definition ==

=== Classical version ===

$$
\delta_{ij} =
\begin{cases}
1, & i=j,\\
0, & i\ne j.
\end{cases}
$$

=== single-index variant ===

$$
\delta_n =
\begin{cases}
1, & n=0,\\
0, & n\ne 0.
\end{cases}
$$

== Properties ==

=== Symmetry ===
$$
\delta_{ij} = \delta_{ji}.
$$

== Application ==

=== Single out the $i$-th term of a sum ===

$$
\sum_j \delta_{ij} a_j = a_i.
$$

=== Identity matrix ===

$$
I_{ij} = \delta_{ij}.
$$
